mapper.select: SELECT projection.attendance_report_projection_id AS projection_id, projection.company_id, projection.period_start, projection.period_end_exclusive, projection.period_state, projection.projection_version, projection.source_snapshot_digest, projection.projection_digest, projection.published_at, employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employee_version.row_version AS employee_version, employment.employment_period_id, employment.assignment_id AS employment_assignment_id, employment.row_version AS employment_version, employment.organization_id FROM attendance_report_projection projection JOIN company company ON company.company_id = projection.company_id AND company.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN employee employee ON employee.company_id = projection.company_id AND employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) <= #{businessDate} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{businessDate} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = projection.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE projection.attendance_report_projection_id = ( SELECT latest.attendance_report_projection_id FROM attendance_report_projection latest WHERE latest.company_id = #{companyId} AND latest.period_start <= #{businessDate} AND latest.period_end_exclusive > #{businessDate} AND latest.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND latest.published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC, latest.attendance_report_projection_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.period_start <= #{businessDate} AND projection.period_end_exclusive > #{businessDate} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND projection.published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.assignment_id LIMIT 2 FOR SHARE
